Owner or custodian: Account holder; identity service and operator are custodians.
Location and protection objective: D1 users in SQLite. Protect hashes and email confidentiality; prevent forged roles or identity changes.

Owner or custodian: Sender and recipient; operator controls storage.
Location and protection objective: D3 messages. Restrict application access to participants; protect body confidentiality and recipient integrity.
D2 reports. Preserve creator ownership and valid pending verified removed and recovered states.
D2 moderator reason and state. Prevent ordinary users from verifying or removing reports.
D4 audit events. Preserve actor object outcome and time; exclude secrets and message bodies. External immutable retention is future work.

Owner or custodian: Operator manages signing secret; application issues sessions.
Location and protection objective: Runtime secret and browser session cookie. Prevent forgery and disclosure; derive authority from the current database user.
Docker volume or Kubernetes PVC and controlled backups. Protect all stored data and restore availability; at-rest encryption is operational.
Pinned requirements container image and CI configuration. Preserve dependency and executable integrity before deployment.
